question: In July 2017, among all visitors who bought any YouTube-related product, which distinct product—excluding those containing ‘YouTube’ in the product name—had the highest total quantity purchased?
sql:
-- Final query: Top product by quantity among YouTube-brand-product buyers
WITH youtube_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
    AND LOWER(p.v2ProductCategory) LIKE '%youtube%'
    AND totals.transactions IS NOT NULL
    AND totals.transactions > 0
)
SELECT 
  p.v2ProductName,
  CAST(SUM(p.productQuantity) AS INT64) as total_quantity
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s
JOIN youtube_buyers yb ON s.fullVisitorId = yb.fullVisitorId
, UNNEST(s.hits) AS h
, UNNEST(h.product) AS p
WHERE s._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
  AND h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'
  AND p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
  AND p.v2ProductName != '(not set)'
  AND LOWER(p.v2ProductName) NOT LIKE '%youtube%'
GROUP BY p.v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1
